text:
lina: Quick Q — we're planning to remove the server-side default model fallback for /v1/generate. What happens to clients that don't set Accept-Model? Do we return 400 or pick a latest-compatible model? Need decision so SDK/docs teams can prep.

josh: Today the runtime silently falls back to the tenant default. The plan was to stop doing that, but we need a clear deprecation path.

marco: Proposed behavior: when Accept-Model header is missing, return 400 with a structured error and a migration hint. Also emit a telemetry event for missing-header attempts so we can measure impact.

kevin: For SDKs we can auto-populate Accept-Model from env REDWOOD_DEFAULT_MODEL to avoid break for most users. SDK change + a short grace period should cover 95%.

sara: Docs/comms note — I'll draft the migration guide. We should include curl examples and a concise explainer of the header. Also add a note in the console UI for tenants using the old default.

marco: Example error shape we want in the 400 (proposal):
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "missing_model_header",
    "message": "Accept-Model header required. Set Accept-Model or pin via SDK config.",
    "hint": "See https://redwood.ai/docs/migrate-accept-model for migration steps"
  }
}
```

josh: Rollout strategy suggestion: feature-flagged enforcement. Canary at 1% on Wed -> 50% after 24h if no regressions -> 100% after 7d. If missing_header 400 rate spikes, rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: Wed 09:00 UTC. Triggering canary pipeline for feature flag= enforce-accept-model.

marco: QA requests: add a smoke test hitting /v1/generate without Accept-Model expecting 400 and matching error_code. Also create a metric missing_model_400_rate and dashboard.

lina: Action items: 1) SDKs: auto-populate Accept-Model env fallback (kevin) 2) Docs: migration guide + examples (sara) 3) Runtime: implement 400 + telemetry + feature flag (josh/marco) 4) Console: add tenant banner about upcoming change (kevin/sara). Can we target PRs by EOD Friday?

kevin: I'll put the SDK PR up today, include env var and opt-out flag.

sara: I'll draft docs + console banner copy and share in PR.

josh: I'll land the runtime change behind the feature flag and wire telemetry. Tests + canary ready.

lina: Great. One more UX ask — include a client-side warning in the hosted dashboard for any tenant with >1000 calls/day that still relies on default. Good to surface before enforcement.

kevin: Will add a dashboard query and banner copy.

sara: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate comms.

lina: Thanks everyone. Follow up in this thread with PR links and any rollback thresholds you want to set. :eyes:
